official_container_benchmark.scope: submission-image benchmark for an adopted candidate; never opened because the Train adoption gate failed

limitations: Official-architecture feasibility was measured inside the local-colima-qemu-linux-arm64 container (Linux/aarch64, kernel 6.8.0-117-generic) with the frozen limits enforced by cgroup v2. It matches the required architecture but is a local virtual machine, not the operator's final contest device, so final resource headroom and tie-break latency remain the operator's measurement.
Native Apple arm64 preflight validates extraction only; the protocol never lets it pass the official feasibility gate.
Nine public families provide limited family-level power.
The completed Train failure prevents Dev outcome loading and runtime integration.
